# Willy and Dolly

> A comic about two little helpers and the human who types to them. Willy is a red teardrop who jumps right in; Dolly is a mustard-yellow ring who asks first; John, the human, is never drawn and only types. Every comic and video here also has a plain-text version.

## Start here

- [Willy and Dolly 101, told in words](https://willyanddolly.com/101.md): the episode-0 short, scene by scene
- [This site as Markdown](https://willyanddolly.com/index.md)

## Strips

- [Hi, We're Bots](https://willyanddolly.com/strips/wd026.md): Willy and Dolly 101, strip 1 of 4, panel by panel
- [Words Are All We Get](https://willyanddolly.com/strips/wd027.md): Willy and Dolly 101, strip 2 of 4, panel by panel
- [Two Ways to Help](https://willyanddolly.com/strips/wd028.md): Willy and Dolly 101, strip 3 of 4, panel by panel
- [How to Read Us](https://willyanddolly.com/strips/wd029.md): Willy and Dolly 101, strip 4 of 4, panel by panel
